summary.text: Lisa Finley-DeVille is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 4A (home city listed as Mandaree), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Finley-DeVille lists an occupation of Advocate.
It lists education as BS, Environmental Science, NHSC; MBA, MMGT, University of Mary.

It also lists Co-Creator, Fort Berthold Protectors of Water and Earth Rights, Board, Dakota Resource Council, Board, West Segment Development Authority, Board, Western Organization Resource Council and Enrolled member, Mandan, Hidatsa, and Arikara Nation.
Family is listed as: Married (Walter Sr.); 5 children; 8 grandchildren.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Finley-DeVille's standing committee assignments as Industry, Business and Labor and Transportation.
